purpose: Define a deterministic preproduction renderer for the 52 licensed A1 MX1 identities without promoting any current root drawing or composition to official visual canon.

invariants: Ordered G-ID identity is never changed.
No semantic meaning is inferred from geometry.
Root drawings remain replaceable assets; layout is independent from root artwork.
rendererContract.compositionTechnique: SVG symbol/use composition; root source paths are external replaceable assets.

rootAssetPolicy.placeholderRule: When a governed root vector is unavailable, render its G-ID in a bounded neutral placeholder. Never present placeholder geometry as the HNK glyph.
rootAssetPolicy.promotionRequirement: Human Visual Gate must review actual governed root artwork before any derived composition can become visual canon.

humanGateDecisions.decision: Approve 1000x1000 normalized composition cell and role-based slots.
Approve PRE-left / NUCLEUS-center / POST-right as V1 visual grammar with no semantic direction claim.
Approve relative scales 0.42 / 0.62 / 0.42 for preproduction testing.
Allow labeled placeholders only when root vector artwork is absent, clearly noncanonical.
Require a second Human Visual Gate after actual 52 compositions are rendered with governed root art.

nextIfApproved: Implement renderer + 52-spec manifest; if root vector source remains unavailable, generate structural contact sheet explicitly marked PLACEHOLDER/NONCANON and open root-art import gate.
